name: Casterbane Shot
prerequisites: Amateur Gunslinger or the grit class feature, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, base attack bonus +4
benefit:
If you ready a ranged attack with a firearm to attack a spellcaster when he begins casting a spell and successfully hit your opponent, you can expend 1 grit point to increase the target’s concentration check DC for being injured while casting by 5.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Weapon Master's Handbook pg. 24
When using Casterbane Shot, you can spend up to 5 stamina points to increase the DC of the concentration check imposed by the feat by an amount equal to the number of stamina points spent.
flavor: Life in the Mana Wastes, where magic has unpredictable and often fatal effects, has taught you to disable spellcasters with your firearms.
